messages:
kevin: Heads up — FP8 canary on L40S is showing weird activation swings for long contexts (>= 4k). Win-rate vs INT8 drops ~1.8% on our chat QA set. Started after the tiling/handshake changes. Need triage ASAP.

maria: which model + canary config? logs? 🧵

kevin: model=redwood-rlhf-13b-v2, canary commit=0f3a9d2, env:
```
FP8_ENABLE=1
KERNEL_VARIANT=tiling_handshake_v2
SEQ_MAX=8192
QUANT_MODE=awq
```
Saw the regression on L40S only; H100 canary looked fine earlier.

sarah: interesting — same kernel variant on H100 vs L40S can behave differently due to tile sizes + mma kernel selection. Per-channel scale mismatch often surfaces as activation clipping only at long seqs. Did you capture per-layer act ranges?

alex: we ran a quick bisect. commit 0f3a9d2 toggled the handshake padding optimization and changed tile stride for kv-cache. suspect mismatch in reshape/packing on L40S kernels.

ci-bot: Canary summary (2834567889) — model=redwood-rlhf-13b-v2, L40S: winrate_delta=-1.8%, avg_logprob_delta=-0.12, failures=14/800, H100: winrate_delta=-0.1%, avg_logprob_delta=-0.01.

maria: please run repro with the longctx harness:
`./eval-runner --model redwood-rlhf-13b-v2 --quant awq --device l40s --batch 1 --seq 4096 --prompts qa_longctx.json --trace=per_layer_ranges`
Compare per-layer scale histograms vs a baseline (INT8/H100).

kevin: attaching a short snippet from the per-layer trace — layer 24 shows scale jumps between 1.2e-3 -> 8.4e-5 at token ~3120, activations clip to +/- 3.2e1 and we see softmax underflow/overflow patterns.
```
L24: scale_before=0.00122 -> scale_after=8.44e-05 @tok3120
L24: max_act=31.9, min_act=-34.1
```

ops-jenna: paused the canary rollout in eu-west-1 for L40S instances. No customer-facing impact yet but keeping it contained. :shield:

sarah: proposed short-term mitigation: when device==L40S and seq>2048, fall back to hybrid FP16 for KV packing or use the older handshake layout. Config patch:
```
kernel_policy:
  fp8_handshake: when seq<=2048
  fp16_kv_pack: when device==L40S and seq>2048
```
This preserves FP8 benefits for typical short contexts while avoiding the longctx clobber.

alex: I'll open PR to gate the handshake optimization by device/seq and add a regression unit that runs the 4k prompts in CI shadow. Will also run a targeted AWQ->GPTQ compare to rule out quant backend issues.

kevin: thanks. also want a quick sanity that this isn't a prompt-driven artifact — can someone run the smoke with a synthetic repeating-token longctx to see if activation swing reproduces? If yes, we can craft a minimal reproducer for kernel devs.

maria: will queue the synthetic run and post results.

ci-bot: scheduled job 2834567905: longctx_synth_repro (L40S). Expected finish ~2h.

kevin: perfect. if reproduces, let's cut a hotfix branch and ship to canary-cage for L40S only. cc @sarah @alex :eyes:

sarah: on it. planning to add more logging around pack/unpack shapes + per-channel scales. should make the root cause obvious.

alex: will shadow-traffic the hotfix after tests. If stable, we can resume rollout.

kevin: thanks team. keep updates short here. :thumbsup:
